title: John Cena vs. Edge: the ultimate opportunist
summary: Edge turns the Money in the Bank contract into a sudden championship win. Cena pursues him through a title rivalry that reaches a TLC match in Toronto.

chapters.title: Edge cashes in
chapters.result: Edge defeats an exhausted John Cena to become WWE champion.
chapters.context: The cash-in follows Cena’s successful Elimination Chamber defense.

chapters.title: Cena wins in Edge’s signature environment
chapters.result: Cena defeats Edge in a TLC Match to win the WWE title.
chapters.context: The championship rivalry reaches a major payoff in Toronto.
